properties.name: has_gaps
properties.description: Whether there are gaps between the sequence features (there exists at least one gap between two features on the same sequence).

properties.name: has_lengths
properties.description: Whether the sequence features have lengths (at least one feature spans more than 1 base pair).

properties.name: has_strands
properties.description: Whether the sequence features are stranded (at least one feature has strand information).

properties.name: has_values
properties.description: Whether the sequence features have associated values (at least one feature has an associated value).

properties.name: has_edges
properties.description: Whether the sequence features are linked across positions (at least one edge between features exists).

properties.name: has_names
properties.description: Whether the sequence features are named (at least one feature has a name).

properties.name: elements_overlapping
properties.description: Whether the sequence features are overlapping (at least one base pair is simultaneously covered by two sequence features).

properties.name: elements_circular
properties.description: Whether the sequence features have circular coordinates (at least one feature that cross a sequence border).

properties.name: lengths_constant
properties.description: Whether the sequence lengths are constant (all sequence features have the same length, excluding features at the very end of a sequence).

properties.name: value_type
properties.description: The type of values associated with the sequence features, if any.

properties.name: edges_have_weights
properties.description: Whether the edges linking sequence features are weighted (at least one edge between sequence features has an associated weight).

properties.name: edge_weight_type
properties.description: The type of values associated with the edges.

properties.name: edges_are_directed
properties.description: Whether the edges linking sequence features are directed (at least one edge between sequence features is defined with a direction).

properties.name: edges_denote_parents
properties.description: Whether the edges linking sequence features denote a parent-child relationship (all edges between sequence features denote parent-child relationships such as genes to exons, i.e. where the child is fully covered by the parent).

valueTypes.name: multiple
valueTypes.description: Multiple types of values are associated (e.g. both integer and string).
